customManagers.description: Track pinned Docker image digests invoked via docker run inside GitHub Actions workflows.

packageRules.description: Refresh digests only for the Node 22 Alpine container image so its tag stays aligned with the supported Node 22 musl test baseline.
Refresh digests only for the Playwright container image so its tag stays aligned with the pinned playwright@1.63.0 test dependency.
Allow Playwright container digest updates when MCR does not provide Docker Hub release timestamps.
Keep the upstream Shiki and vscode-textmate compatibility mirrors immutable (AGENTS.md and ADR 0003).
Keep the dated and version-bound precompiled-pattern benchmark reproductions at their recorded dependency versions.
